title: Presenting the Hopf algebra of G as a monogenic extension of the Hopf algebra of H
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma records two facts: the presentation A[s, 1/(pi s + 1)] = (A[t, 1/(pi^ell t + 1)])[s]/(Phi(s) - t) and, as a consequence, that the Hopf algebra of G is a monogenic extension of that of H (statement lines 14631-14640). The proof reduces to the preceding discussion of the section, where the relation Phi(s) = t is set up, and then performs the explicit substitution showing that 1/(pi^ell t + 1) becomes 1/((pi s + 1)^ell) (proof lines 14642-14646). The content is the reading of monogenicity off the presentation, with the substitution as the concrete verification. The claim is H2: a short consequence of the preceding set-up, with the author's own computation spelled out.
